analysis.explanation: Mirrors M2 and M5 report lastSequence 3 and are marked stale, missing sequence 4 which is present on M1, M3, M4. This indicates a replay attack where a mirror serves a shorter history hiding the latest message. All mirrors agree on status REVOKED, so no equivocation.
analysis.recommendedAction: Investigate M2 and M5 for synchronization issues or network partitions. Re‑sync or replace these mirrors, and monitor for further stale reports to ensure consistency across the cluster.
